data_objects.name: hotel_listings
data_objects.meaning: Hotel and lodging listings with location, rating, review, property-type, and brand affiliation fields.
data_objects.notes: Brand fields can be blank for properties without a recorded affiliation.

variables.name: hotel_id
variables.meaning: Identifier of the listed hotel or lodging property.

variables.name: hotel_name
variables.meaning: Name of the hotel or lodging property.

variables.name: star_rating
variables.meaning: Recorded star classification for the property.

variables.name: bubble_score
variables.meaning: Recorded bubble-style review score for the property.

variables.name: review_count
variables.meaning: Number of reviews associated with the property.

variables.name: hotel_type
variables.meaning: Property-type category, such as hotel or condo.

variables.name: parent_brand_name
variables.meaning: Recorded parent organization for the hotel brand.

structure.description: Each row represents one lodging property, with hotel_id serving as its record identifier.
brand_name and parent_brand_name form a nested affiliation when both are present.

uncertainties: The provider, collection date, bubble-score scale, and review source are not identified.
The table does not distinguish a true lack of brand affiliation from an unrecorded affiliation.
annotation_notes: Rating and affiliation meanings are limited to the explicit field labels and encodings in train.csv.
